create.name: Jana Roemer
create.bio:
Jana Roemer is a Canadian yoga nidra teacher and astrologer who grew up on the Saskatchewan prairie and now lives in a small lakeside town near Nelson, British Columbia. She has been practising and studying yoga for more than two decades. Her yoga nidra training began with Tanis Fishman and went on to include Rod Stryker's ParaYoga Nidra, and she taught for years in Alberta and later at well-known studios in Venice, California, where she also ran yoga and yoga nidra teacher trainings.

Her signature practice, which she calls Astro Nidra, joins guided yoga nidra with the current astrological weather, so each session is tied to the moon's sign or the season of the sun. These now live on Attune to the Moon, an online membership she built that shows practices according to real planetary positions and gathers members for a virtual circle at each new moon. She also sells single Astro Nidras, runs an online course on the foundations of yoga nidra and sends out a seasonal astrology zine by post. Most of her work is online, but she hosts an annual nature retreat in Nelson that mixes daily practice with time on the lakes and in the forest.

courses.title: Attune to the Moon Membership
courses.description: Her main online home: a library of more than 250 Astro Nidras, breath practices, walking meditations and journal prompts that rotate with the real positions of the planets. Members also join a live virtual circle at each new moon.

courses.title: Sleep Yourself Awake: The Transformative Power of Yoga Nidra
courses.description: A self-paced online course on what actually happens during yoga nidra and how to choose and work with a sankalpa, or heartfelt intention. It mixes short lessons with full guided practices, including several Astro Nidras.

courses.title: Astro Nidras (single practices)
courses.description: Individual Astro Nidra recordings for each zodiac season, available to download one at a time for anyone who does not want the full membership.

courses.title: PAPER Ritual (an Astro Letter Club)
courses.description: A seasonal astrology zine, a personal letter and a small item for a new moon ritual, posted to you each sun season. Text-message astrology notes are an optional add-on in the USA and Canada.
courses.price: $13 USD a month ($17 USD a month with micro COSMOS)

courses.title: Remember Your Nature Retreat (Nelson, BC)
courses.description: Her yearly small-group retreat in Nelson, British Columbia, with long morning practices, evening yoga nidra or breathwork, local organic meals and days out on the river, lake and forest trails. Places are by application.

free_resources.title: Jana Roemer on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Free yoga nidra sessions and guided meditations, some shaped around the moon and astrology, to listen to in the app or on the web.
